extractions.quote: Table. Criteria of SPS [3]. Clinical: - rigidity in the axial and abdominal muscles, leading to formation of lumbar hyperlordosis; - painful muscle spasms triggered by tactile and emotional stimuli; - absence of other neurological diseases, explaining the above symptoms; Neurophysiological: - constant activity of motor units according to EMG; Auxiliary: - detection of anti-GAD antibodies and antibodies to amphiphysin in blood plasma and CSF: - positive test with diazepam.

Table. Criteria of SPS [3]. Clinical: - rigidity in the axial and abdominal muscles, leading to formation of lumbar hyperlordosis; - painful muscle spasms triggered by tactile and emotional stimuli; - absence of other neurological diseases, explaining the above symptoms;
Auxiliary: - detection of anti-GAD antibodies and antibodies to amphiphysin in blood plasma and CSF:
Neurophysiological: - constant activity of motor units according to EMG;
Auxiliary: - positive test with diazepam.
